Verses.VerseAr: اَتٰۤى اَمۡرُ اللّٰهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡهُ‌ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The promise of Allah has drawn (near), so do not hasten in seeking it. Holy is He and exalted far above those objects which the disbelievers set up as (His) peers.

Verses.VerseAr: يُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةَ بِالرُّوۡحِ مِنۡ اَمۡرِهٖ عَلٰى مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖۤ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرُوۡۤا اَنَّهٗ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا فَاتَّقُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He alone sends down the angels by His Command with Revelation (which is the spirit of all the teachings of Din [Religion]) to those of His servants He likes: ‘Warn (the people) that there is no God except Me, so adopt fearing Me against all evils.’

Verses.VerseAr: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He alone has created the heavens and the earth with a zero-defect strategy. He is exalted far above those objects which the disbelievers set up as (His) peers.

Verses.VerseAr: خَلَقَ الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ نُّـطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He alone has created man from a drop of vital fluid, yet he has become openly contentious (instead of becoming totally submissive to Allah).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡاَنۡعَامَ خَلَقَهَا‌ۚ لَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا دِفۡءٌ وَّمَنَافِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He alone has created for you cattle. They are for you a source of warm clothing and (other) benefits. And you (also) eat some of them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا جَمَالٌ حِيۡنَ تُرِيۡحُوۡنَ وَحِيۡنَ تَسۡرَحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is beauty in them (and also a joy — an aesthetic pleasure) for you when you drive (them back) in the evening from pasture and when you drive (them) out in the morning (to graze).

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَحۡمِلُ اَثۡقَالَـكُمۡ اِلٰى بَلَدٍ لَّمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا بٰلِغِيۡهِ اِلَّا بِشِقِّ الۡاَنۡفُسِ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوۡفٌ رَّحِيۡمٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these (animals also) carry your loads to those distant cities (and remote areas) where you cannot reach (otherwise) without toiling hard. Surely your Lord is Most Clement, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّالۡخَـيۡلَ وَالۡبِغَالَ وَالۡحَمِيۡرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوۡهَا وَزِيۡنَةً‌ ؕ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (He is the One Who has created) horses, mules and donkeys so that you may ride them and that they may serve as means of adornment (for you) as well and He will (further) create (such ornamented means of conveyance) that you do not know (today).

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ قَصۡدُ السَّبِيۡلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآٮِٕرٌ‌ؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدٰٮكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the middle course reaches (the door of) Allah and many crooked side tracks also (branch off) from it. And had He so willed, He would have guided all of you.

Words.MeaningEn: surely He would have guided you

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً‌ لَّـكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٌ وَّمِنۡهُ شَجَرٌ فِيۡهِ تُسِيۡمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who has sent down for you water from the sky. (Some) of it is to drink and (some) of it is for plantation. (You grow with it plants, vegetation and pastures) wherein you take (your cattle) to graze.

Verses.VerseAr: يُنۡۢبِتُ لَـكُمۡ بِهِ الزَّرۡعَ وَالزَّيۡتُوۡنَ وَالنَّخِيۡلَ وَالۡاَعۡنَابَ وَمِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّـقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: With the same water He grows for you crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Indeed there are Signs in it for those who reflect and meditate.

Verses.VerseAr: وَسَخَّرَ لَـكُمُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَۙ وَالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ‌ؕ وَالنُّجُوۡمُ مُسَخَّرٰتٌۢ بِاَمۡرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيٰتٍ لِّـقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He (is the One Who) has subjected to your service the night and the day and the sun and the moon, and all the stars have also been made subservient to (the system according to) His strategy. Surely there are Signs in it for those who possess reason.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا ذَرَاَ لَـكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا اَلۡوَانُهٗ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لّـِقَوۡمٍ يَّذَّكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (of the animal world, vegetable world and minerals) whatever He has created for you in the earth which have separate colours (genders, species, classes, characteristics and benefits, etc. — all have been subdued to your service). Verily, there is a Sign in it for those who take advice.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ سَخَّرَ الۡبَحۡرَ لِتَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡهُ لَحۡمًا طَرِيًّا وَّتَسۡتَخۡرِجُوۡا مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةً تَلۡبَسُوۡنَهَا‌ۚ وَتَرَى الۡـفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيۡهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who has subjected sea (rivers and oceans) as well (in addition to air and land) so that you may eat fresh (and favourite) seafood from there and may take out from them gems (etc.) that you wear as ornaments. And, (O man,) you see the vessels (and ships) that pierce through the water (of the rivers and oceans). And (all this has been managed) so that you may look for His bounty (i.e. sustenance, far and wide) and also that you may become thankful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَلۡقٰى فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ رَوَاسِىَ اَنۡ تَمِيۡدَ بِكُمۡ وَاَنۡهٰرًا وَّسُبُلاً لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who has created firm mountains in the earth (by allying various elements) lest it tremors while carrying you (revolving in its orbit), and rivers and (also natural) routes so that you may find way (to reach the destinations),

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَلٰمٰتٍ‌ؕ وَبِالنَّجۡمِ هُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And set up landmarks (to navigate during the day). And (at night as well) people find (their) way by means of the stars.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ يَّخۡلُقُ كَمَنۡ لَّا يَخۡلُقُ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Can the Creator Who creates (all that) be like the one who cannot create (anything)? Do you not then accept advice?

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ تَعُدُّوۡا نِعۡمَةَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحۡصُوۡهَاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَـغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you want to count the favours of Allah, you will not be able to number them all. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah knows what you hide and what you show.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُوۡنَ شَيْئًا وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the (idols) whom these (polytheists) worship besides Allah cannot create anything; they have rather been created themselves.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡوَاتٌ غَيۡرُ اَحۡيَآءٍ‌ۚ وَّمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They) are non-living, inanimate objects which do not (even) sense when the people will be raised up.

Verses.VerseAr: اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ‌‌ ۚ فَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ مُّنۡكِرَةٌ وَّهُمۡ مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Your God is One God. So those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deniers at heart and are beliers and arrogant.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is verily true and established that Allah knows all that they hide and all that they show. Surely He does not like the defiers and arrogant.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ مَّاذَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ‌ۙ قَالُـوۡۤا اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when they are asked: ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they retort: ‘False fables of the people gone by (have been sent down).’

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَحۡمِلُوۡۤا اَوۡزَارَهُمۡ كَامِلَةً يَّوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ‌ۙ وَمِنۡ اَوۡزَارِ الَّذِيۡنَ يُضِلُّوۡنَهُمۡ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍ‌ؕ اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They are making all these utterances) so that they may carry full load (of their evildoings) on the Day of Resurrection and also (carry) some load of those that they are misguiding due to (their) ignorance. Beware! It is an extremely evil load which they are carrying.

Verses.VerseAr: قَدۡ مَكَرَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَاَتَى اللّٰهُ بُنۡيَانَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ السَّقۡفُ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَاَتٰٮهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No doubt those who lived before them (also) devised plots, but Allah knocked down the edifice (of their deceptive plots) from its foundations, and the roof caved in upon them, and the torment came at them from where they never thought of.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يُخۡزِيۡهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُنۡتُمۡ تُشَآقُّوۡنَ فِيۡهِمۡ‌ؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوۡا الۡعِلۡمَ اِنَّ الۡخِزۡىَ الۡيَوۡمَ وَالسُّوۡۤءَ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then He will humiliate them on the Day of Resurrection and say: ‘Where are those that you set up as peers to Me and in whose favour you disputed (with the believers)?’ Those endowed with knowledge will say: ‘Today (all types of) humiliation and destruction will surely befall the disbelievers,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ تَتَوَفّٰٮهُمُ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ ظَالِمِىۡۤ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ‌ فَاَلۡقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَـعۡمَلُ مِنۡ سُوۡۤءٍؕ بَلٰٓى اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌۢ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whom the angels cause to die while they are (constantly) doing wrong to their own souls.’ They will display obedience and submission (on the Day of Resurrection and say:) ‘We were not used to doing any evil (in the world).’ No indeed! Allah surely has thorough knowledge of what you used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: فَادۡخُلُوۡۤا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا‌ؕ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, enter the gates of Hell. You are its permanent residents. So how evil is the abode of the arrogant!

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِيۡلَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا مَاذَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ‌ؕ قَالُوۡا خَيۡرًاؕ لِّـلَّذِيۡنَ اَحۡسَنُوۡا فِىۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٌ‌ ؕ وَلَدَارُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ خَيۡرٌ‌ؕ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (when) the Godfearing are asked: ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they say: ‘All good (for here and the Hereafter has been sent down).’ There is good for those who do good in this world (too), and certainly the House of the Hereafter is even better. And how excellent is the house of those who are Godfearing!

Verses.VerseAr: جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ يَّدۡخُلُوۡنَهَا تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ‌ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا يَشَآءُوۡنَ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَجۡزِىۡ اللّٰهُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There are Gardens of Eternity which they will enter with streams flowing under them. Therein will be (available) whatever they will long for. That is how Allah rewards the God-fearing.

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ تَتَوَفّٰٮهُمُ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ طَيِّبِيۡنَ‌ۙ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمُۙ ادۡخُلُوۡا الۡجَـنَّةَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The angels take their lives while they are pure, clean, pleased and contented (due to obedience and piety. The angels tell them the moment they take their lives:) ‘Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise due to (the pious deeds) that you used to do.’

Verses.VerseAr: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ اَوۡ يَاۡتِىَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ‌ؕ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلٰـكِنۡ كَانُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And what else are they waiting for except that the angels should come to them or there should reach the command (of torment) from your Lord? Those before them (also) did the same. And Allah did not do them any wrong but they themselves used to wrong their own souls.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So the punishments that came upon them were due to the acts that they had perpetrated, and the same (chastisement) they used to make fun of engulfed them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَشۡرَكُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ نَّحۡنُ وَلَاۤ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ‌ۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who set up peers with Allah say: ‘Had Allah so willed, We would not have worshipped anything apart from Him, neither we nor our fathers. Nor would we have forbidden anything without His (Command).’ Those before them (also) did the same. Are the Messengers responsible for anything in addition to conveying clearly (the Message and Commandments of Allah)?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِىۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوۡلاً اَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَاجۡتَنِبُوۡا الطَّاغُوۡتَ‌ۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ هَدَى اللّٰهُ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ الضَّلٰلَةُ‌ ؕ فَسِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَانْظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We sent a Messenger in every people: ‘(O people,) worship Allah and keep away from Taghut (i.e. Satan and idol-worship).’ Then some among them were those whom Allah guided, and there were others among them for whom misguidance proved (appropriate). So travel through the land and see what was the end of those who belied (the Truth)!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ تَحۡرِصۡ عَلٰى هُدٰٮهُمۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ يُّضِلُّ‌ وَمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: If you ardently desire them to take the path of guidance then (let not your sanctified disposition be overburdened), for indeed Allah does not guide him whom He holds strayed, nor do they have any helpers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَقۡسَمُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ جَهۡدَ اَيۡمَانِهِمۡ‌ۙ لَا يَبۡعَثُ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ يَّمُوۡتُ‌ؕ بَلٰى وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقًّا وَّلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they swear by Allah most earnestly that Allah will not resurrect him who dies. No Indeed! The true promise is a bountiful obligation upon Him, but most people do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِىۡ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ وَلِيَـعۡلَمَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا كٰذِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The dead will be raised up again) so that He makes evident (the Truth) wherein they disagree and that the disbelievers may realize that they alone are in fact liars.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا قَوۡلُـنَا لِشَىۡءٍ اِذَاۤ اَرَدۡنٰهُ اَنۡ نَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Our Command for a thing is but only this much that when We intend (to bring) it (into existence) We say to it: ‘Be,’ and it becomes.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هَاجَرُوۡا فِىۡ اللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡا لَـنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ فِىۡ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةً‌ ؕ وَلَاَجۡرُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَكۡبَرُ‌ۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who emigrated after they had been subjected to (different kinds of) torture and brutality, We will certainly provide them with a better abode in this (very) world. And the reward in the Hereafter is certainly greater. Would that they knew (this secret) —

Words.MeaningEn: surely We will give them position

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord!

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالاً نُّوۡحِىۡۤ اِلَيۡهِمۡ‌ فَسۡــَٔلُوۡۤا اَهۡلَ الذِّكۡرِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And before you also We sent only men as Messengers towards whom We sent Our Revelations. So if you yourselves do not know (anything), then ask the People of Remembrance.

Verses.VerseAr: بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِ‌ؕ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ الذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They too were sent) with clear proofs and the Books. And, (O Glorious Messenger,) We have revealed to you the Glorious Reminder (the Qur’an) so that you may explain clearly to people (the Message and the Commandments) that have been sent down to them and that they may meditate.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَاَمِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ مَكَرُوۡا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ يَّخۡسِفَ اللّٰهُ بِهِمُ الۡاَرۡضَ اَوۡ يَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have these evil and deceitful people gone free of the fear that Allah may sink them into the earth, or may send to them torment from (any) quarter that is beyond their imagination?

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ يَاۡخُذَهُمۡ فِىۡ تَقَلُّبِهِمۡ فَمَا هُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or He may seize them during their movements (travelling and business trips). So, they cannot hinder Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ يَاۡخُذَهُمۡ عَلٰى تَخَوُّفٍؕ فَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوۡفٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or He may seize them for being struck with fear. Indeed your Lord is Most Compassionate, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلٰى مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ يَّتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلٰلُهٗ عَنِ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَالشَّمَآٮِٕلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمۡ دٰخِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen those (shady) objects which Allah has created; their shadows keep crawling on the right and the left sides prostrating themselves before Allah? And, (in fact, in this way) they display humbleness and obedience.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلِلّٰهِ يَسۡجُدُ مَا فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ وَّالۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, all living beings and angels prostrate themselves before Allah (alone) and are not (in the least) proud and arrogant.

Verses.VerseAr: يَخَافُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُوۡنَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ ۩‏
Verses.VerseEn: They keep fearing their Lord, Who is high above them, and obey whatever the command they are given.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ اللّٰهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوۡۤا اِلٰهَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ‌ۚ اِنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰـهٌ وَّاحِدٌ‌ ۚ فَاِيَّاىَ فَارۡهَبُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has ordained: ‘Do not take two gods; assuredly He (Allah) alone is the only One God. So fear Me alone persistently.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَهٗ مَا فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَهُ الدِّيۡنُ وَاصِبًا‌ؕ اَفَغَيۡرَ اللّٰهِ تَتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whatever is in the heavens and the earth (all) belongs to Him alone, and obligatory (for all) is obedience to Him alone. Do you then fear (anyone) other than Allah?

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا بِكُمۡ مِّنۡ نّـِعۡمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ‌ ثُمَّ اِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَاِلَيۡهِ تَجْئَرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whatever blessing you have been provided with is from Allah alone. Then, when some distress afflicts you, you wail and weep only before Him.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنۡكُمۡ اِذَا فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when Allah removes that distress from you, a party from amongst you starts setting up partners with their Lord;

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَاۤ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ‌ؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوۡا‌ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (This disbelief and polytheism is perpetrated) so that they may show ingratitude for those (blessings) which We have bestowed upon them. So, (O polytheists,) take this (a few days’) benefit, then soon will you know (your end).

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ نَصِيۡبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ‌ؕ تَاللّٰهِ لَـتُسۡــَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنۡتُمۡ تَفۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they ascribe a portion of the provisions which We have given them for those (idols) whose (reality) even they themselves do not know. By Allah, you will indeed be asked about what you fabricate.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ الۡبَـنٰتِ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ‌ۙ وَلَهُمۡ مَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they (the disbelievers and polytheists) ascribe daughters to Allah. Glory be to Him, (He is far above that;) and for themselves they prefer what they desire (i.e. sons).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِالۡاُنۡثٰى ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the news (of the birth) of a daughter is disclosed to any of them, his face turns dark and he gets pent up with anger.

Verses.VerseAr: يَتَوَارٰى مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ مِنۡ سُوۡۤءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهٖؕ اَيُمۡسِكُهٗ عَلٰى هُوۡنٍ اَمۡ يَدُسُّهٗ فِىۡ التُّرَابِ‌ؕ اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He seeks to hide himself from people due to the (presumed) bad news that is given to him. (He now gets down to thinking) whether he should keep her (alive) despite humiliation and disgrace or bury her (alive) in the earth. See! How wicked is the decision that they make!

Words.MeaningEn: he has been given od news

Verses.VerseAr: لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوۡءِ‌ۚ وَلِلّٰهِ الۡمَثَلُ الۡاَعۡلٰى‌ ؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (This) is the most evil attribute of those who do not believe in the Hereafter and the most exalted attribute is only Allah’s. And He is Almighty, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ اللّٰهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلۡمِهِمۡ مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيۡهَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ وَّلٰـكِنۡ يُّؤَخِّرُهُمۡ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌‌ۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَـاۡخِرُوۡنَ سَاعَةً‌ وَّلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had Allah seized people (instantly) for their injustice, He would not have left any living being (on the surface of the earth). But He grants them respite till an appointed term. When their fixed time arrives then they can neither advance nor hold it back for a single moment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ مَا يَكۡرَهُوۡنَ وَتَصِفُ اَلۡسِنَـتُهُمُ الۡـكَذِبَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ الۡحُسۡنٰى‌ؕ لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَاَنَّهُمۡ مُّفۡرَطُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they attribute to Allah what they loathe (for themselves) and their tongues utter falsehood that there is good for them. (No indeed!) The truth is that for them there is Hell, and they will be the first ones to be sent (into Hell where they shall be left forever).

Verses.VerseAr: تَاللّٰهِ لَـقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلٰٓى اُمَمٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By Allah! We certainly sent Messengers to (many) people before you (also). Then Satan made their (evil) deeds look attractive and pleasing to them. So the same (Satan) is today their friend. And for them there is painful punishment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡـكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِىۡ اخۡتَلَـفُوۡا فِيۡهِ‌ۙ وَهُدًى وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّـقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not revealed to you the Book except that you may explain those (matters) clearly to them in which they differ, and (also that this Book) is guidance and mercy for the people that have embraced faith.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah pours down water from the sky and by means of that brings the earth to life (i.e. makes it fertile and green) after it has become dead (i.e. barren and infertile). Surely there is in it a Sign for those who give ear (to advice).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ لَـكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَنۡعَامِ لَعِبۡرَةً‌ ؕ نُّسۡقِيۡكُمۡ مِّمَّا فِىۡ بُطُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِ فَرۡثٍ وَّدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآٮِٕغًا لِّلشّٰرِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed in the cattle (too) there is a point for you to ponder. We provide you with pure milk to drink brought forth from that substance of their bellies (which is produced by) compounding (certain) intestinal contents and blood and which freshens up those who drink it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ ثَمَرٰتِ النَّخِيۡلِ وَالۡاَعۡنَابِ تَتَّخِذُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ سَكَرًا وَّرِزۡقًا حَسَنًاؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you obtain sugar and (other) fine foods from the fruits of date-palms and grapes. Indeed there is a Sign in it for those who have reason.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَوۡحٰى رَبُّكَ اِلَى النَّحۡلِ اَنِ اتَّخِذِىۡ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُيُوۡتًا وَّمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord seeded (the idea instinctually) in the honeybee’s heart: ‘Make your hives in certain mountains and certain trees and (also) in certain projections which people build aloft (like roofs).

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ كُلِىۡ مِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ فَاسۡلُكِىۡ سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلاً‌ ؕ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡۢ بُطُوۡنِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ اَلۡوٰنُهٗ فِيۡهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, suck the juice of all kinds of fruit and then follow those routes (suggested) by your Lord (which lead to these fruits and flowers of which you are to suck the juice, leading other bees also to the source) for their convenience.’ There oozes from their bellies a syrup (that is honey) of diverse colours. It has healing properties for the people. Therein is indeed a Sign for those who apply their minds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفّٰٮكُمۡ‌ۙ وَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّرَدُّ اِلٰٓى اَرۡذَلِ الۡعُمُرِ لِكَىۡ لَا يَعۡلَمَ بَعۡدَ عِلۡمٍ شَيْئًا ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌ قَدِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has brought you into being; then He causes you to die (i.e. takes your life); and He turns some of you to the most worthless age (senility) so that after knowing (so much in life) he should now know nothing (i.e. man may see to his helplessness and paucity of resources before death). Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ فَضَّلَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ فِىۡ الرِّزۡقِ‌ۚ فَمَا الَّذِيۡنَ فُضِّلُوۡا بِرَآدِّىۡ رِزۡقِهِمۡ عَلٰى مَا مَلَـكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ سَوَآءٌ‌ ؕ اَفَبِنِعۡمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has preferred some of you to others in (grades of) provision, (so that He may bring you to trial through the command of spending in His way). But those who have been preferred do not divert (even a portion of) their wealth to (i.e. do not spend on) their dependants while they all are equal in it (as for as their basic necessities are concerned). So do they deny Allah’s favour?

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا وَّجَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡ بَنِيۡنَ وَحَفَدَةً وَّرَزَقَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ‌ؕ اَفَبِالۡبَاطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ وَبِنِعۡمَتِ اللّٰهِ هُمۡ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has created for you spouses from among yourselves, and has created through your mates (wives) sons and grandsons and provided you with pure sustenance. Do they still believe in falsehood (abandoning the Truth) and disregard Allah’s favours?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقًا مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ شَيْئًا وَّلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And besides Allah they worship those (idols) who are helpless to provide them with any provision from the heavens and the earth, and nor do they have any power.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تَضۡرِبُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الۡاَمۡثَالَ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ وَاَنۡـتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So never put forward any similitude about Allah. Surely Allah knows and you do not.

Verses.VerseAr: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلاً عَبۡدًا مَّمۡلُوۡكًا لَّا يَقۡدِرُ عَلٰى شَىۡءٍ وَّمَنۡ رَّزَقۡنٰهُ مِنَّا رِزۡقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنۡفِقُ مِنۡهُ سِرًّا وَّجَهۡرًا‌ؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوٗنَ‌ؕ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah has explained an example (that) there is a slave, possessed by (some master), having no control over anything (himself); and (the other) is the one We have given the best provision, so he gives out to others out of it secretly and openly: can the two be held equal? All praise belongs to Allah alone. But most of them do not know (even the basic reality).

Verses.VerseAr: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلاً رَّجُلَيۡنِ اَحَدُهُمَاۤ اَبۡكَمُ لَا يَقۡدِرُ عَلٰى شَىۡءٍ وَّهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلٰى مَوۡلٰٮهُۙ اَيۡنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَاۡتِ بِخَيۡرٍ‌ؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِىۡ هُوَۙ وَمَنۡ يَّاۡمُرُ بِالۡعَدۡلِ‌ۙ وَهُوَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has illustrated an example of two (such) men of whom one is dumb, has no power over anything and is a burden on his master; wherever he (the master) sends him, he brings no good. Can he (the dumb) be the equal to the (other) one who (holds such an office that he) enjoins the people to do justice, and he himself also follows the straight path?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَمَاۤ اَمۡرُ السَّاعَةِ اِلَّا كَلَمۡحِ الۡبَصَرِ اَوۡ هُوَ اَقۡرَبُ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And to Allah belongs (all) the unseen of the heavens and the earth and the advent of the Last Hour will be as quick as twinkling of an eye or even faster. Surely Allah has Mighty Control over everything.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ اَخۡرَجَكُمۡ مِّنۡۢ بُطُوۡنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ  شَيْئًا ۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَـكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصٰرَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَ‌ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers (in such a state) that you knew nothing, and He endowed you with ears and eyes and hearts so that you may give thanks.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَى الطَّيۡرِ مُسَخَّرٰتٍ فِىۡ جَوِّ السَّمَآءِؕ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen the birds that fly aloft in the air (under the law of motion and aerodynamics)? Nothing but (the laws of) Allah hold them (in the sky). Surely there are Signs in (this law of aerodynamics) for the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡۢ بُيُوۡتِكُمۡ سَكَنًا وَّجَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ جُلُوۡدِ الۡاَنۡعَامِ بُيُوۡتًا تَسۡتَخِفُّوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ظَعۡنِكُمۡ وَيَوۡمَ اِقَامَتِكُمۡ‌ۙ وَمِنۡ اَصۡوَافِهَا وَاَوۡبَارِهَا وَاَشۡعَارِهَاۤ اَثٰثًا وَّمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has made your homes (permanent) places for you to reside and made for you (temporary) dwellings (i.e. tents) with the skins of cattle which you find light enough during your journey and for (stay at journey-breaking) halts. And (Allah is the One Who) provides you with household goods and profitable means (in business and trade) from the wool of sheep and lambs and fur of camels and hair obtained from goats, (which are) for an appointed term.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلٰلاً وَّجَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِبَالِ اَكۡنَانًا وَّجَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ سَرَابِيۡلَ تَقِيۡكُمُ الۡحَـرَّ وَسَرَابِيۡلَ تَقِيۡكُمۡ بَاۡسَكُمۡ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهٗ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah is the One Who has made for you shades of many things that He created, and He has made places of shelter for you in the mountains, and He has made (some) such clothes for you as protect you from heat and (others like) coats of armour which shield you (against the enemy assault) during the event of intense war. Thus Allah perfects His favour and blessing (provision and protection) upon you so that you may bow down (before His Presence) with absolute submissiveness.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So if (even then) they turn away (O Glorious Messenger,) then your responsibility is only to convey and communicate (My Message and My Commands) clearly.

Verses.VerseAr: يَعۡرِفُوۡنَ نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ يُنۡكِرُوۡنَهَا وَاَكۡثَرُهُمُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They recognize Allah’s favour, then deny it and most of them are disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ نَـبۡعَثُ مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيۡدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤۡذَنُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when We shall raise from every people (their Messenger as) a witness (to their deeds), then the disbelievers will not be accorded permission (to put forward any excuse), nor will they be asked (then) to turn to Allah in repentance.

Words.MeaningEn: will be asked to make amends

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا رَاَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوا الۡعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the wrongdoers see the torment, neither will (this torment) be mitigated for them, nor will they be granted any respite.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا رَاَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَشۡرَكُوۡا شُرَكَآءَهُمۡ قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا هٰٓؤُلَۤاءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا الَّذِيۡنَ كُنَّا نَدۡعُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِكَ‌ۚ فَاَلۡقَوۡا اِلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلَ اِنَّكُمۡ لَـكٰذِبُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the idolaters see their (self-made) partners, they will say: ‘O our Lord, these are our partner-gods which we worshipped besides You.’ Thereupon those (partner-gods) will send them the message (in reply): ‘You are liars indeed.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَلۡقَوۡا اِلَى اللّٰهِ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ ۨالسَّلَمَ‌ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that Day these (polytheists) will show humbleness and obedience to Allah, and all falsehood that they used to fabricate will vanish from them.

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ زِدۡنٰهُمۡ عَذَابًا فَوۡقَ الۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يُفۡسِدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who disbelieved and kept hindering (others) from the path of Allah, We shall add torment to their torment because they used to spread mischief and spoil peace.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ نَـبۡعَثُ فِىۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيۡدًا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ‌ وَجِئۡنَا بِكَ شَهِيۡدًا عَلٰى هٰٓؤُلَۤاءِ‌ؕ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡـكِتٰبَ تِبۡيَانًا لِّـكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّهُدًى وَّرَحۡمَةً وَّبُشۡرٰى لِلۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (this) will be the Day (when) We shall raise in every people one witness against them from among themselves, and, (O Venerable Beloved,) We shall bring you as witness to all of them (communities and Messengers). And We have revealed to you that Glorious Book which is a clear exposition of everything and is guidance, mercy and glad tidings for the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَاۡمُرُ بِالۡعَدۡلِ وَالۡاِحۡسَانِ وَاِيۡتَآىِٕ ذِىۡ الۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَيَنۡهٰى عَنِ الۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَالۡمُنۡكَرِ وَالۡبَغۡىِ‌ۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed Allah enjoins justice and benevolence (towards everyone), and giving away to the kindred and forbids indecency, evil deeds, defiance and disobedience. He admonishes you so that you may remember with concern.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَوۡفُوۡا بِعَهۡدِ اللّٰهِ اِذَا عٰهَدتُّمۡ وَلَا تَنۡقُضُوۡا الۡاَيۡمَانَ بَعۡدَ تَوۡكِيۡدِهَا وَقَدۡ جَعَلۡتُمُ اللّٰهَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَفِيۡلاً‌ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And always fulfil the promise of Allah when you promise, and do not break oaths after making them firm while you have already made Allah a surety over you. Surely Allah knows well whatever you do.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا كَالَّتِىۡ نَقَضَتۡ غَزۡلَهَا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٍ اَنۡكَاثًاؕ تَتَّخِذُوۡنَ اَيۡمَانَكُمۡ دَخَلاًۢ بَيۡنَكُمۡ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ اُمَّةٌ هِىَ اَرۡبٰى مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ‌ؕ اِنَّمَا يَبۡلُوۡكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖ‌ؕ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَـكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not be like the woman who after spinning her yarn firm and strong breaks it into pieces. You employ your oaths as a means of deceiving among you so that (by this) one party may earn more profit than the other. The matter is that Allah (also) puts you to trial through the same, and on the Day of Resurrection He will certainly make clear those matters in which you used to disagree.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَـعَلَكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰـكِنۡ يُّضِلُّ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَيَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ‌ؕ وَلَـتُسۡــَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had Allah so willed He would have made (all) of you one Umma (Community) but He holds strayed whom He wills and leads to guidance whom He wills. And you will surely be asked about the deeds you used to do.

Words.MeaningEn: And surely you will be questioned

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوۡۤا اَيۡمَانَكُمۡ دَخَلاًۢ بَيۡنَكُمۡ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعۡدَ ثُبُوۡتِهَا وَتَذُوۡقُوۡا السُّوۡۤءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمۡ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ‌ۚ وَلَـكُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not use your oaths as a means of deceiving among you lest your foot should quiver after it is set firmly (in Islam) and you will taste the evil result because you used to hinder (the people) from the path of Allah. And there is severe torment for you.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَشۡتَرُوۡا بِعَهۡدِ اللّٰهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيۡلاً‌ ؕ اِنَّمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٌ لَّـكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not barter the promise made to Allah for a paltry price (i.e. worldly wealth and gains). Surely (the reward) that is with Allah is best for you if you know (this secret).

Verses.VerseAr: مَا عِنۡدَكُمۡ يَنۡفَدُ‌ وَمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ بَاقٍؕ وَلَـنَجۡزِيَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡۤا اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِاَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The (riches) that you possess will be no more and what is with Allah will last. And those who remain steadfast We shall certainly pay their recompense for their righteous deeds which they used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًـا مِّنۡ ذَكَرٍ اَوۡ اُنۡثٰى وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَـنُحۡيِيَنَّهٗ حَيٰوةً طَيِّبَةً‌ۚ وَّلَـنَجۡزِيَـنَّهُمۡ اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِاَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever performs pious works, man or woman provided he or she is a believer, We will surely let such a one live a life of purity and will indeed reward them (as well) their wage of the righteous works which they used to do.

Words.MeaningEn: then surely We will give him life

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا قَرَاۡتَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ الرَّجِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when you undertake to recite the Qur’an, seek refuge with Allah against (the wiles of) Satan, the outcast.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّهٗ لَـيۡسَ لَهٗ سُلۡطٰنٌ عَلَى الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely he has no control (at all) over those who believe and put their trust in their Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا سُلۡطٰنُهٗ عَلَى الَّذِيۡنَ يَتَوَلَّوۡنَهٗ وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِهٖ مُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He overpowers only those who make friends with him and who associate partners with Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا بَدَّلۡنَاۤ اٰيَةً مَّكَانَ اٰيَةٍ‌ۙ وَّاللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّمَاۤ اَنۡتَ مُفۡتَرٍؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when We substitute some Verse in place of another Verse, and Allah (alone) knows best whatever He sends down, (then) the disbelievers say: ‘You are but a forger!’ But most of them do not know (the rationale of sending down and substituting the verses).

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ نَزَّلَهٗ رُوۡحُ الۡقُدُسِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ بِالۡحَـقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَهُدًى وَّبُشۡرٰى لِلۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘The Holy Spirit (Gabriel) has brought it (the Qur’an) down from your Lord with truth so as to keep the believers firm-footed and (this) is guidance and good news for the believers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ نَـعۡلَمُ اَنَّهُمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهٗ بَشَرٌ‌ؕ لِسَانُ الَّذِىۡ يُلۡحِدُوۡنَ اِلَيۡهِ اَعۡجَمِىٌّ وَّهٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We know that they (the disbelievers and the polytheists) say: ‘It is but a human being who teaches him this (Qur’an).’ But the person they point to, turning the matter away from the truth, is the one whose language is non-Arabic and this Qur’an is (in) clear and unambiguous Arabic language.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِۙ لَا يَهۡدِيۡهِمُ اللّٰهُ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who do not believe in the Revelations of Allah, Allah does not provide them with guidance (i.e. does not also enable them with understanding and insight). And for them is grievous torment.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا يَفۡتَرِىۡ الۡـكَذِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ‌ۚ وَاُولٰۤٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡكٰذِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed they alone invent false fabrications who do not believe in the Revelations of Allah and they alone are liars.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ كَفَرَ بِاللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ اِيۡمَانِهٖۤ اِلَّا مَنۡ اُكۡرِهَ وَقَلۡبُهٗ مُطۡمَٮِٕنٌّۢ بِالۡاِيۡمَانِ وَلٰـكِنۡ مَّنۡ شَرَحَ بِالۡكُفۡرِ صَدۡرًا فَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ‌ۚ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The one who disbelieves after having believed, except someone who is coercively forced to do so and at heart remains contented with belief (as before), but (of course) he who (adopts) disbelief (afresh) wholeheartedly with an open mind, on them is wrath from Allah and for them is fierce torment.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اسۡتَحَبُّوۡا الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا عَلَى الۡاٰخِرَةِۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِىۡ الۡقَوۡمَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That is because they loved and preferred the life of this world to the Hereafter and because Allah does not guide the disbelieving folk.

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصَارِهِمۡ‌ۚ وَاُولٰۤٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡغٰفِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They are those whose hearts and whose ears and whose eyes Allah has sealed and they are the ones who are neglectful (of their end in the Hereafter).

Verses.VerseAr: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is a fact that these are certainly those who are the losers in the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ هَاجَرُوۡا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَا فُتِنُوۡا ثُمَّ جٰهَدُوۡا وَصَبَرُوۡۤاۙ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then your Lord, for those who emigrated (i.e. left their homes and towns for the cause of Allah) after they had been made to suffer from trials (and adversities), then fought in the way of Allah and remained steadfast (in the face of worries); after that, (O Glorious Beloved,) your Lord is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Words.MeaningEn: they had been put to trials

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ تَاۡتِىۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهَا وَتُوَفّٰى كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (recall the time) that Day when every person will appear pleading for himself (in his defence), and every soul will be given full recompense for whatever it will have done, and they will not be wronged in the least.

Words.MeaningEn: and will be paid in full

Verses.VerseAr: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلاً قَرۡيَةً كَانَتۡ اٰمِنَةً مُّطۡمَٮِٕنَّةً يَّاۡتِيۡهَا رِزۡقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّنۡ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتۡ بِاَنۡعُمِ اللّٰهِ فَاَذٰقَهَا اللّٰهُ لِبَاسَ الۡجُـوۡعِ وَالۡخَـوۡفِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَصۡنَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has described the example of a township which was (living) in peace and contentment. The means of sustenance came to (its residents) in abundance from all quarters. Then the (dwellers) of this town disregarded Allah’s blessings and showed ingratitude. Thereupon Allah clothed them in the torment of hunger and fear due to the activities that they used to carry out.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ وَهُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed there came to them from among themselves a Messenger but they denied him. So the torment seized them and they were certainly the wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: فَكُلُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ حَلٰلاً طَيِّبًا وَّاشۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So always eat of that clean and lawful sustenance which Allah has given you and thank for the favour of Allah if you worship but Him alone.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَيۡتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحۡمَ الۡخِنۡزِيۡرِ وَمَاۤ اُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ اللّٰهِ بِهٖ‌ۚ فَمَنِ اضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٍ وَّلَا عَادٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He has forbidden you only carrion, blood, the flesh of swine and (the animal) on which the name of other than Allah is invoked at the time of slaughter. But he who is faced with survival condition (forced by necessity), neither defying (against Allah’s injunctions seeking taste of lust), nor transgressing (the limit of necessity), then Allah is surely Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَقُوۡلُوۡا لِمَا تَصِفُ اَلۡسِنَـتُكُمُ الۡكَذِبَ هٰذَا حَلٰلٌ وَّهٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّـتَفۡتَرُوۡا عَلَى اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ‌ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ لَا يُفۡلِحُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not tell a lie which your tongues utter: ‘This is lawful and that is forbidden,’ thus fabricating a lie against Allah. Indeed those who fabricate lies against Allah will (never) be delivered.

Verses.VerseAr: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيۡلٌ وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There is only a little profit but the torment for them is painful (beyond proportion).

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَلَى الَّذِيۡنَ هَادُوۡا حَرَّمۡنَا مَا قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ‌ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰـكِنۡ كَانُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We made unlawful for the Jews the same things that We have mentioned to you before and We did not wrong them but they used to wrong their souls themselves.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ عَمِلُوۡا السُّوۡۤءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوۡا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصۡلَحُوۡۤا اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed your Lord, for those who committed wrongs out of ignorance, then turned to Him in repentance and amended (their) state, then surely after that your Lord is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ كَانَ اُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيۡفًاؕ وَلَمۡ يَكُ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely Ibrahim (Abraham) was an Umma ([Community] in himself), exclusively obedient to Allah, turning away from all falsehood (ever inclined and given to Him alone) and was not of those who associate partners with Allah,

Verses.VerseAr: شَاكِرًا لِّاَنۡعُمِهِ‌ؕ اِجۡتَبٰٮهُ وَهَدٰٮهُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Grateful to (Allah) for His blessings. Allah chose him (and exalted him to a high office in His Presence) and guided him to the straight path.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ فِىۡ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةً‌ ؕ وَاِنَّهٗ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We bestowed upon him good in this world, and he will surely be of the upright in the Hereafter (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ اَنِ اتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ حَنِيۡفًا‌ؕ وَّمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, (O Glorious Beloved,) We sent down Revelation to you: ‘Follow Din (Religion) of Ibrahim (Abraham), who was at variance with every falsehood and was not of those who associate partners with Allah.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبۡتُ عَلَى الَّذِيۡنَ اخۡتَلَفُوۡا فِيۡهِ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Saturday (the Sabbath) was ordained only for those who differed about it, and indeed your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection (in the matters) in which they used to differ.

Verses.VerseAr: اُدۡعُ اِلٰى سَبِيۡلِ رَبِّكَ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَالۡمَوۡعِظَةِ الۡحَسَنَةِ‌ وَجَادِلۡهُمۡ بِالَّتِىۡ هِىَ اَحۡسَنُ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ ضَلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖ‌ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُهۡتَدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Glorious Messenger!) Invite towards the path of your Lord with strategic wisdom and refined exhortation and (also) argue with them in a most decent manner. Surely your Lord knows him well who strayed away from His path and He also knows well the rightly guided.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ عَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَعَاقِبُوۡا بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوۡقِبۡتُمۡ بِهٖ‌ۚ وَلَٮِٕنۡ صَبَرۡتُمۡ لَهُوَ خَيۡرٌ لِّلصّٰبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you want to punish, then punish only (as severely) as you were afflicted, but if you remain patient then certainly that is better for those who keep patience.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ‌ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِىۡ ضَيۡقٍ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Glorious Beloved,) be patient and your patience is by Allah alone. And you should not grieve over their (defiance), nor distress (your gracious and benevolent heart) on account of their deceptive plots.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مُّحۡسِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely Allah blesses them with His (special) companionship who live with Godwariness and who (also) live with spiritual excellence.
